customManagers.description: Keep the hk version embedded in .pkl package URLs in sync with the hk release (Renovate's mise manager bumps mise.toml, but not the pkl URLs)

Keep the hk-config version embedded in consumer .pkl package URLs in sync with the hk-config@<version> GitHub release (tooling itself imports Defaults.pkl by relative path, so this only fires in consumer repos)

packageRules.description: Group actionlint updates (mise tool + .chezmoidata version comment share one rhysd/actionlint release)
Group hk updates (mise tool + .pkl package URLs share one release)

Fold hk-config into the hk group — Defaults.pkl is built against a specific hk Config/Builtins version, so the amends pin and the hk-config import must move together or both intermediate states break. Matched by depName (emitted by the hk-config customManager above), not by source URL: gtbuchanan/tooling also publishes @gtbuchanan/cli, which must stay out of this group
Group pkl updates (mise tool + .chezmoidata version comment share one apple/pkl release)
Group pnpm updates (the mise tool and package.json's packageManager field pin the same release)
Group powershell updates (mise tool + .chezmoidata version comment share one PowerShell/PowerShell release)
Ignore microsoft/playwright-cli v0.180.0 mistag (release body says v0.0.62)
Restrict noisy pre-commit hook updates to bi-monthly
Throttle the noisy renovate CLI (mise npm:renovate, used by hk's renovate-config-validator step) to bi-monthly
Skip release-age quarantine for gtbuchanan's own packages
